hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) [ "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = "main" ] && { echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"ERROR: direct commits to main are not allowed — create a branch first"}'; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *'git merge'*) echo "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--no-ff' || { echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"ERROR: git merge requires --no-ff — use: git merge --no-ff <branch>"}'; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE 'git push[^&;|]*' | while read -r seg; do if echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]]|:)main([[:space:]]|$)' || { ! echo "$seg" | grep -qE '^git push([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]*)*[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]-]+[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]-]' && [ "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = "main" ]; }; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"ERROR: direct pushes to main are not allowed — open a PR"}'; exit 2; fi; done; exit $?
